name: RL Replay
description: Open-loop replay of RL-solved input sequences (solution.json) tick-for-tick in the real game. Proves the training replica is exact.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Arm the replayer. F8 toggles this in-game.

solutions-dir.name: Solutions directory
solutions-dir.description: Folder holding <levelID>.json solutions (from python -m gdrl.deploy). Empty = <mod save dir>/solutions.

block-input.name: Block human input
block-input.description: Drop your own jump presses while a replay is armed.

log-trace.name: Log trace CSV
log-trace.description: Write a format=3 per-tick trace (same schema as the trace-logger mod) for trace_check.

auto-retry.name: Auto-retry after death
auto-retry.description: Keep replaying on every restart. Off = disarm after the first death so its trace is preserved.
